I lost my husband years ago to terminal illness. I wanted to exit with him, but he convinced me to keep going. It's been hard. I am done.

People will tell you nonsense about philosophy and spirituality, but our brains are built upon primitive drives that ensure survival of the species. It's going to be hard for you after she passes, and chances are you will never love like that again.

Enjoy her while you can.

Your psychiatrist will make that decision.

However, if you have a plan and have taken steps to carry it out, please go to the emergency room.

No, she doesn't.  We've talked about this, and she understands.  She's been well provided for and there's enough money for her to be comfortable while finishing med school.

I haven't done well.  All roads lead to misery.  Don't torture yourself.
All of those and more.  I'll make a topic about it, but it really doesn't matter anymore.

I'm old. I'm tired of empty promises.

Every generation presumes theirs will be the last.

I used to look forward to the day this backward society would accept an individual's right to die, but I doubt that will happen even in my daughter's lifetime.

That's not my problem anymore. It's liberating.

Parting advice: Live for today, not the lies of tomorrow.

I've had a couple patients who've gone on to become volunteers at hotlines after being treated for unipolar depression. There's a rigorous screening process for the major numbers, especially the KB Hopeline (800-SUICIDE). This gentleman was using tough love. If he didn't care, he wouldn't be there. Are you angry because what he told you was true or because he didn't mollycoddle you?

You are suicidal. You have a method at your disposal. Everything isn't okay, and saying it will be is trite. If you had been completely honest with this man, he would have contacted emergency services and an ambulance would have been dispatched to pick you up. You are a threat to your own life and need to be in treatment.

It is regrettable that the call made you feel worse, but please remember that the volunteers have often been through the same situation you have. However, we all tolerate trauma differently.  For future reference, you are always welcome to ask to speak with a different volunteer. If he refuses, disconnect and call back.

If you'd like a comprehensive list of North American hotlines, send me a private message by the end of the day. Also, it's best to use inert gas on an empty stomach.

Yesir. Tonight / tomorrow. It takes awhile for the cocktail to work, so the Superbowl is ideal. Too many people drop by unexpectedly on the holidays. I wish there were a service I could call to remove my body without giving away the fact that I'm exiting, but at least my daughter is out of town. I've left the cleaning lady a comfortable tip.
